summary.zhCn: Litecoin 创建者、前 Google 与 Coinbase 工程师、Litecoin Foundation 董事。档案核查其家庭教育、公开启动、2017年处置 LTC 及财富边界。
summary.en: Creator of Litecoin, former Google and Coinbase engineer, and Litecoin Foundation director. The dossier examines his family and education, fair-launch record, 2017 LTC divestment, and wealth boundaries.
